Row.Text: 陆地作战单位迎战基础战斗力更强的单位时+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。不是由本文明建立的城市每回合+3忠诚度。
Land combat units receive +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when fighting a unit with higher base Combat Strength. Cities not founded by this civilization gain +3 Loyalty per turn.
陆地单位（含平民和支援单位）进入丘陵不额外消耗移动力。山脉为商业中心提供+1 [ICON_Gold] 金币、为工业区提供+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力的标准相邻加成。

Land units (including civilian and support units) ignore the movement cost of Hills. Mountains provide a standard adjacency bonus of +1 [ICON_Gold] Gold to Commercial Hubs and +1 [ICON_Production] Production to Industrial Zones.
每个单位的维护费-1 [ICON_Gold] 金币。兵营及其建筑不再产出大将军点数，改为兵营+2 [ICON_Production] 生产力、其中每座建筑再+2 [ICON_Production] 生产力。与兵营相邻的所有改良设施（农场、矿山、种植园、营地等）+1 [ICON_Food] 粮食、+1 [ICON_Production] 生产力。

Unit maintenance costs are reduced by 1 [ICON_Gold] Gold per unit. Encampments and their buildings no longer generate Great General points; instead the Encampment gains +2 [ICON_Production] Production and each of its buildings another +2 [ICON_Production] Production. All improvements adjacent to an Encampment (Farms, Mines, Plantations, Camps and so on) gain +1 [ICON_Food] Food and +1 [ICON_Production] Production.

桃园结义：建立首都及研究特定科技时，五虎上将免费加入。[NEWLINE]厚施恩德，以收众心：城市施加的忠诚度压力+50%。因忠诚度脱离其他文明的城市，在本文明施加的忠诚度压力最高时，跳过自由城市阶段直接加入本文明。

Oath of the Peach Garden: the Five Tiger Generals join for free when the [ICON_Capital] Capital is founded and as certain technologies are researched.[NEWLINE]Win Hearts with Generous Virtue: cities exert +50% Loyalty pressure. Cities rebelling from other civilizations join this civilization directly, skipping the Free City stage, when its Loyalty pressure on them is highest.
关羽、张飞、赵云、马超、黄忠。
Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Ma Chao and Huang Zhong.

+{1_Amount} 五虎上将：文艺复兴时代

建立首都时加入的重骑兵，远古基础34 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力，4 [ICON_Movement] 移动力。武圣：进攻时+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。万军丛中：无视区域控制。斩首：进攻后，若敌方单位剩余生命值不高于20，直接将其斩杀。过五关斩六将：击杀敌方单位后恢复20生命值。[NEWLINE]五虎上将之一：达成加入条件后在首都旁免费加入，不能训练或购买，阵亡后不再出现。统率：2格内（含自身）的己方陆地作战单位+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力、+1 [ICON_Movement] 移动力，可与大将军叠加。虎将之勇：生命值低于50时+7 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力，低于25时再+7。没有维护费，可以获得经验和晋升，但不能升级。本文明每进入一个新时代+8 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力（远程攻击同样生效）。

Heavy cavalry that joins when the [ICON_Capital] Capital is founded. Ancient-era base 34 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength, 4 [ICON_Movement] Movement. God of War: +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when attacking. Through Ten Thousand: ignores Zone of Control. Beheading: after attacking, an enemy unit left with 20 HP or less is killed outright. Five Passes, Six Generals: heals 20 HP after killing a unit.[NEWLINE]One of the Five Tiger Generals: joins for free next to the [ICON_Capital] Capital once its condition is met; cannot be trained or purchased and never returns once killed. Command: friendly land combat units within 2 tiles (including this unit) receive +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength and +1 [ICON_Movement] Movement; stacks with Great Generals. Tiger's Courage: +7 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength below 50 HP, and another +7 below 25 HP. No maintenance; earns experience and promotions but cannot upgrade. +8 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength (ranged attacks included) for each new era this civilization enters.

Friendly land combat units within 2 tiles (including this unit) receive +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength and +1 [ICON_Movement] Movement, with no era limit. Stacks with Great Generals but not with other Tiger Generals.
在五虎上将2格范围内：+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力、+1 [ICON_Movement] 移动力。

This unit and adjacent friendly units heal an extra 20 HP per turn (like a Medic).
攻击后仍可移动：斩将之后脱身。
Can move after attacking, to break away after a kill.
破城：攻击城墙不受削弱（同攻城槌），与城市和区域作战时+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。
Siege breaker: full damage against walls (like a Battering Ram) and +10 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength when fighting cities and districts.
每回合可攻击两次，斩首线提高到35生命值。每杀死一个敌方单位，9格内与你交战的城市忠诚度-20。
Can attack twice per turn and Beheading triggers at 35 HP or less. Each enemy unit he kills costs enemy cities at war with you within 9 tiles 20 Loyalty.
击败敌方作战单位时将其收降，成为己方单位（同私掠船「战利品」的俘获机制）。
Captures defeated enemy combat units, which join your army (the same capture mechanic as the Privateer Prize promotion).
受伤不降低战斗力，虎将之勇的残血加成全额生效。
Does not lose Combat Strength when damaged, so Tiger's Courage applies in full.
统率范围内的单位再+5 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。
Units under his Command receive an additional +5 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength.
虎将之勇多一档：生命值低于75时也+7 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力。
Tiger's Courage gains a tier: +7 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength already below 75 HP.
相邻的交战敌方单位-7 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力（同毛利 Toa 的机制）。
Adjacent enemy units at war with you receive -7 [ICON_Strength] Combat Strength (the same mechanic as the Maori Toa).

+1 [ICON_Movement] 移动力。击败蛮族单位时将其收编（同秦始皇（一统天下）的机制）。
+1 [ICON_Movement] Movement. Defeated barbarian units join your army (the same mechanic as Qin Shi Huang the Unifier).

对抗骑兵单位+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力，抵消其克制。

击杀敌方单位后恢复30生命值。
Heals 30 HP after killing a unit.
对骑兵类单位再+10 [ICON_Strength] 战斗力，+1 [ICON_Movement] 移动力。
